hooks.name: Browser Smoke Test Reminder
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, remind the agent to run a quick browser smoke test (login verification) if the local Docker environment is running.

action.prompt: After completing this task, if the local Docker environment is running (minilibrary-web on port 3000), perform a quick browser smoke test: use Playwright MCP to navigate to http://localhost:3000/login, verify the page loads with the MiniLibrary heading, perform a Dev Login as Member, and confirm the authenticated dashboard loads. Report pass/fail briefly.
